root.description: The id of the root the paths are under

path.description: The file the condition is about, relative to its root: the package.json for TSCONFIG_INVOKED_MISSING, the config for TSCONFIG_REACHES_OUTSIDE_GIT

code.description: `TSCONFIG_INVOKED_MISSING`: a script names a tsconfig file that is not git content; the invocation row has a null `config`, and the condition is at the package.json; `TSCONFIG_REACHES_OUTSIDE_GIT`: a literal `files` entry, or an `include` entry with no `*` or `?`, names a path that is not git content; it is filtered from the members, and the condition is at the config

seq.description: 0-based position among the path's conditions of this code

kind.description: For TSCONFIG_REACHES_OUTSIDE_GIT, which literal entry reaches outside git content; null otherwise

reached.description: For TSCONFIG_REACHES_OUTSIDE_GIT, the path the entry names, relative to the root; null otherwise

projection-tsconfig-conditions.description: A row of the derived `tsconfig_conditions` relation
